result.finding: Java Maven project with 10 declared dependencies in pom.xml (8 compile/runtime, 2 test-scope). Spring Boot BOM manages versions. Dependencies are resolved and packaged into a fat JAR during the Docker build stage via 'mvn clean package'.
evidence: Dockerfile: COPY pom.xml . and COPY src ./src — pom.xml and source copied into build stage
Dockerfile: RUN mvn dependency:go-offline -B and RUN mvn clean package -DskipTests — Maven resolves and bundles all dependencies
pom.xml: spring-boot-starter-parent v2.7.18 (BOM manages versions for Spring dependencies)
2 test-scope dependencies (spring-boot-starter-test, h2) — not bundled in final JAR
values: Runtime/compile dependencies: spring-boot-starter-web, spring-boot-starter-thymeleaf, spring-boot-starter-data-jpa, ojdbc8 (runtime), spring-boot-starter-validation, commons-io:2.11.0, spring-boot-starter-json, spring-boot-devtools (optional)
Install method: mvn clean package (fat JAR)
